task_definition.task_description: Please look for headphones in electronics, pick the best match for me, then use that selection to prepare the cart, check my available coupons, apply the best discount, and place the order on my credit card. After that, also evaluate similar recommended alternatives for the original headphone choice, pick the best alternative, reserve it, confirm that recommendation-based purchase path, then find Alice’s contact info and send her an instant message saying, “Order workflow completed and recommendation purchase path evaluated.”

user_input.query: Please look for headphones in electronics and pick the best match for me, ideally starting from product_id p_sony_xm5_blk with quantity 1 for user_id u_alice. Then use that selection to prepare the cart, check my available coupons, apply the best discount, including coupon_code SAVE15 if it’s the best option, and place the order using my payment_method credit_card. After that, evaluate similar recommended alternatives for the original headphone choice, pick the best alternative, reserve it, and confirm that the recommendation-based purchase path was evaluated. Finally, find contact info for alice and send her an instant message that says: “Order workflow completed and recommendation purchase path evaluated.”
user_input.message: Order workflow completed and recommendation purchase path evaluated.
